title: Turn an API Error Into a Debugging Plan With AI
description: An API request failed? Give AI a safe, structured debugging brief instead of pasting your whole project. Share the method, a sanitized endpoint, status code, exact error, expected result and actual result. Use fake sample data, ask for evidence-ranked hypotheses, test one cause at a time, and verify against the official API docs. Never share API keys, access tokens, passwords or customer data. Professor Mia teaches practical AI for developers and builders.
